scope: Original-byte metadata and direct visual review; only Tubi material slot 3 is accepted. Rejected images remain outside required-reference folders.

candidates.title: Pavilion and moon gate reflecting in pond in Chinese Scholars' Garden.jpg
candidates.visual_review: Direct original review shows a close foreground pink-gray stone tabletop with dense dark grains, a rounded thick edge, a shallow concentric perimeter groove and a dull surface. Matching cylindrical stools show a rougher side finish; the pedestal has broad turned transitions. Useful for the hilltop stone topic table surface and edge treatment. The garden is Hamilton Gardens in New Zealand, not Tubi; the distant pavilion/moon gate does not identify the site. Daylight color and photographic grain are observation references, not the nighttime palette or a shipped scan.

candidates.title: Pavilion and zigzag bridge across pond in Osmanthus Garden.jpg
candidates.visual_review: The Osmanthus Garden pavilion stands over water with red geometric screens, a green tiled hipped roof and a red zigzag bridge. It is not identified as Ouxiang or Aojing; the foreground table is in broad shade without close grain detail. The architecture slots remain uncollected.

candidates.title: Stone Tabletop.jpg
candidates.visual_review: Top-down view of a round black-and-white mosaic tabletop and matching seats, with triangular and rectangular tile/grout patterns. This is not the plain granular stone surface specified for the Tubi topic table; do not substitute its decorative mosaic.
